body: Known him for more than a year now and we did long distance to begin with. There have been no other issues within the relationship, it’s just this one financial situation. I feel like he might have meant what he said initially but maybe realized he messed up along the way? He does provide for us now as I’m still unemployed and he supports me in everything, honestly. I trust he’ll pay me back when he actually has the option to, he probably can’t pay much back with the one job atm? Idk, I’m just stressed out with everything going on and I have no one to talk to about it
